title: Judy M
content: I was getting a diagnostic mammogram. During one of the poses, I got hot and felt like I was going to faint. Then I fainted for a short time. The staff helped me up. While gone, I went to a brightly lit place. The grass was a beautiful green and fairly flat. There were small groups of little children around. They wore shirts tucked into pants, and all had little belts. One of them came to me as I appeared on the green. We were walking toward an edge. Somehow he communicated to me that I was loved, more than once. I said to myself, "They love me. I am loved. They love me." The light was just there with no sun and no shadows, just a pleasantly bright light. There was no conversation or words exchanged. I knew what they were saying. At the very end, I said to myself, "I don't want to come back," as staff members were helping me after I had fainted.

elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, Light, color of the grass, kids that communicated with me without speaking.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I didn't feel loved.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, A child walked to me and then with me.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes, The other little kids were off in the distance talking among themselves.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, They loved me. I am loved.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I am sure that God loves me.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, I am learning details all the time, and I never told anyone right away.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Over the years I learned about others' NDEs and realized mine was similar.
